params.prompt: A full-page website design, desktop 1440 wide, for a small welding shop's contact page. The page is a photoreal shop work-order ticket lying on a brushed-steel workbench under a cool work light: a heavy light-grey card with a black hazard stripe, the attached chrome emblem (gear ring, welder, TRUST WELDING, EST 2025) printed at the top, the heading "Tell me about the job", four form fields (Name, Phone, What do you need built or fixed?, Where is it?) drawn as ruled boxes, a solid teal-blue button "Send the request", and three small buttons "Text 425-283-6496", "Call", "Instagram". A dark site header above with the emblem and the phone number. Masculine, industrial, crisp, legible, no rust, no wood.
